part.name: Scissor-lift linkage assembly with slotted platform rails
part.description: A 12-solid mechanical assembly consisting of two vertically separated platform or guide rails, four crossed linkage plates arranged in front and rear pairs, four long corner pivot pins, and two short central pivot pins. Elongated slots at one end of each rail permit the corresponding linkage pivots to translate while the opposite pivots remain at circular pin interfaces.
part.symmetry_note: The assembly has paired front and rear scissor linkages offset along CAD Z. The lower and upper rails are geometrically similar and offset along CAD Y. Four corner pins form a rectangular arrangement in the CAD XY plane, while the linkage plates cross about a shared central pivot axis parallel to CAD Z.

semantic_orientation.description: CAD Y is interpreted as the lift-height direction, with the rail at larger Y being the upper platform and the rail at smaller Y being the lower platform. CAD X follows the rail length, and CAD Z spans the front-to-back width between the two linkage sets.
